PLAINTIFF'S MOTION TO COMPEL FURTHER DEPOSITION AND FOR A PROTECTIVE ORDER; REQUEST FOR APPOINTMENT OF DISCOVERY REFEREE IS GRANTED AS IT SEEKS TO COMPEL DEFENDANT'S FURTHER DEPOSITION. THE COURT FINDS THAT THERE WAS NO GOOD CAUSE TO SUSPEND THE DEPOSITION. THE COURT DOES NOT ADDRESS ANY SPECIFIC QUESTIONS, BUT THE PARTIES ARE ADVISED THAT THE COURT DOES NOT FIND THAT ANY QUESTIONS WERE IMPROPER OR BURDENSOME. THE MOTION IS DENIED AS IT SEEKS THE APPOINTMENT OF A DISCOVERY REFEREE. THE DEPOSITION SHALL BE RESUMED AND COMPLETED BEFORE ANY OTHER DEPOSITIONS ARE TAKEN. THE COURT FINDS THAT THE SUSPENSION OF THE DEPOSITION WAS A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. THE COURT IMPOSES SANCTIONS AGAINST DEFENDANT AND HER COUNSEL IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,495, TO BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER.
